notes.input: 1091 x 852 px. Scale 93 px/m from door widths, wall thicknesses and printed room areas.
notes.seg: SegFormer output, pixel by pixel: dark = wall, orange = door, blue = window, light blue = room.
notes.elements: Recognised 45 walls (14 exterior), 10 doors, 11 windows, 7 rooms - these build the 3D model and the takeoff.
notes.gt: Ground truth (CubiCasa5K annotation). 72% of our wall centre-lines lie within 15 cm of a true wall; 96% of the true walls were found. Rooms 7 of 6. Scale error -7%, cost error +12% vs the cost from the annotation.
